proposed_comments.title: Preserve deferred drag-package resources
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve deferred drag-package resources

**Severity:** `high`

Please preserve the source `DataPackageView` resource map when copying item drag data. The current drag helper copies requested operation, properties, and formats, but it drops `ResourceMap` entries used by HTML/images and other deferred payloads. Precompute the resource map before drag start where the API can still be awaited, cancel list-item drags when the map is not ready, and add coverage proving the resource map survives the shelf/list drag copy.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The verified fix spans CommandItemViewModel, DataPackageTransfer, ListItemsView, ShellPage, and view-model tests; it is not safely represented by one independently applicable inline suggestion.

confidence.rationale: The converged fork added DataPackageResourceMapTask, async resource-map copy, TryCopy gating, and regression tests, and the exact upstream head still drops ResourceMap entries.

proposed_comments.title: Do not force copied shelf payloads to move operations
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not force copied shelf payloads to move operations

**Severity:** `high`

Shelf items backed by an extension `DataPackage` can advertise `Copy` or `Link` operations, but the current shelf drop handlers always accept `Move` for reorder, pin, and remove targets. That can misreport the completed drag operation to the source and break external drag payload semantics. Carry the source package's requested/allowed operation through drag start and use the preferred copied operation for accepted shelf drops, falling back to `Move` only for shelf-internal items without an external data package.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The correction touches drag start, drag-over, drop, remove, pin, and cleanup state in ShellPage; a single-line suggestion would be incomplete.

confidence.rationale: The current handlers force DataPackageOperation.Move even after copying a source package whose RequestedOperation may be Copy or Link; the fork fix tracks and reuses the preferred operation.

proposed_comments.title: Distinguish persisted pins from items shown in the pinned section
proposed_comments.body:
### Distinguish persisted pins from items shown in the pinned section

**Severity:** `medium`

`CanPin` is currently based on whether the composed shelf item is in the pinned section. When recent commands are shown before pinned commands, an item that is already persisted as pinned can also appear in the recent section with `IsPinned == false`, making the UI offer to pin a command that is already persisted. Track whether each item exists in the persisted pinned-command set separately from its current visual section, and base pin eligibility/reorder acceptance on that persisted state.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The verified fix adds persisted-pin state to QuickAccessShelfItem equality/reuse and computes it from QuickAccessShelfViewModel, so it is a coordinated view-model change rather than a localized replacement.

confidence.rationale: The fork fix adds IsPersistedPinned, includes it in reuse/equality, computes it from pinned command IDs, and adds a regression for a recent-section item that remains persisted pinned.

proposed_comments.title: Include local directory bookmarks in storage-item drag data
proposed_comments.body:
### Include local directory bookmarks in storage-item drag data

**Severity:** `medium`

The bookmark list item builds storage-item drag data only when the classified target is one of the file-like kinds and `File.Exists` returns true. Local directory bookmarks therefore cannot be dragged as folders even though the helper already supports resolving directories through `StorageFolder`. Include `CommandKind.Directory` and accept `Directory.Exists` when creating the local path package, with regression coverage for a local directory bookmark.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The behavior crosses bookmark classification and the shared indexer drag-data helper; the tested request is safer as an author-facing companion than a narrow partial patch.

confidence.rationale: The current condition excludes CommandKind.Directory before DataPackageHelper can use its StorageFolder path; the fork fix and new test cover this exact gap.

proposed_comments.title: Keep the indexer drag helper internal
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the indexer drag helper internal

**Severity:** `low`

`DataPackageHelper` is an implementation detail of the indexer/bookmark drag-data path, but the PR exposes it publicly. Please keep the helper `internal` and grant the bookmark extension friend access only if that sharing is intentional; this avoids adding unnecessary public API surface while preserving the cross-extension reuse.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: This is a small API-surface cleanup tied to the bookmark/indexer sharing decision and project friend access, not a standalone current-line suggestion.

confidence.rationale: The fork changed the helper back to internal and added InternalsVisibleTo for the bookmark extension, preserving behavior without widening public surface.
